CORE MATHEMATICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #13
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: CORE MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In the number 3547, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 40
   C. 400
   D. 4

2. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 50
   B. 7
   C. 14
   D. 49

3. What is 8 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 33
   C. 12
   D. 32

4. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 90
   C. 81
   D. 36

5. What is 8 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 0
   B. 16
   C. 65
   D. 64

6. Solve for x: x + 7 = 12. (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 6
   C. 5
   D. 12

7. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 169
   C. 170
   D. 26

8. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 5
   C. 25
   D. 26

9. What is 4 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 37
   C. 5
   D. 36

10. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 8 cm and 15 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 23
   B. 17
   C. 7
   D. 19

11. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 144
   C. 156
   D. 48

12. What is 4 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 9
   B. 1
   C. 20
   D. 21

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

MARKING SCHEME
====

1. A — 10

2. D — 49
Working:
1. Formula / relationship: Square = number × number
2. Substitute values: 7² = 7 × 7
3. 7² = 49
Final Answer: 49
Mark reminder: method mark; accuracy mark

3. D — 32
Working:
1. Formula / relationship: Product = first factor × second factor
2. Substitute values: Product = 8 × 4
3. Product = 32
Final Answer: 32
Mark reminder: method mark for multiplication; accuracy mark for answer
